clips.title: The story
paras: The Tundrid Hills are a rugged, snowbound stretch of highland in south-central Dun Morogh, lying just west of the Gol'Bolar Quarry. Inhabited by dangerous mountain wildlife, the rocky passes are rarely traversed by casual travelers.

Stretching between Coldridge Valley and the lowlands of eastern Dun Morogh, the Tundrid Hills offer a rugged cross-country route for those looking to bypass the main roads through Kharanos. However, convenience comes at a steep price. The jagged snowy slopes are prowled by ferocious predators, making the territory perilous for unwary travelers who venture off the beaten path without a drawn weapon.
